svg.title: HPC Learning Hub NestJS modules, 2026-09-04
svg.desc: TrainingLibraryModule serves the first two public views. Later features reuse it. Auth and Users support private features. Database and Observability are backend infrastructure. Arrows are NestJS imports, not request flow.
